author: artlbv
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds a standalone, fully resolved configuration of the Phase-2 L1 emulation (track trigger, trigger primitives, correlator/GTT/GMT/calo emulators and the P2GT menu), set up like the Phase-2 HLT menu (`HLT_75e33_cff`). The goal is a single, era-free L1 configuration that can be inspected, diffed and eventually stored like an HLT menu. Tracking issue: https://github.com/artlbv/cmssw/issues/10.

- **`L1Trigger/Configuration/python/L1_Phase2_cff.py` + `L1_Phase2/{modules,eventsetup,sequences,paths}`:** one `_cfi` per object, no era/modifier logic. It contains 187 modules, 26 ES objects, 35 sequences/tasks and 46 paths. The paths are listed in schedule order in `l1Paths`; there is no `fragment.schedule`, so loading the fragment doesn't touch `process.schedule`.
  - The Run-3 legacy chain (17 modules feeding only `simGtStage2Digis`/`simBmtfDigis`/`simCscTriggerPrimitiveDigisRun3`) runs in its own `L1TLegacyRun3Task` / `L1simulationLegacy_step`.
  - Dropped: modules that are loaded but never scheduled, and PSets that nothing references.
  - Not included: geometry, magnetic field and GlobalTag (they come from the driver, as for the HLT).
  - Module labels are unchanged, so DQM, ntuplizers and the HLT see the same products.
  - The MC-truth chain (the `TT*Associator*` modules and `DisplacedVertexProducer`, which reads the track association map unconditionally) runs in its own `L1TrackTriggerMCTruthTask` / `L1TrackTriggerMCTruth_step`. The generator fails if any other module depends on it.
  - Top-level PSets that modules reference with `refToPSet_` are kept in `psets/`: the P2GT cos/cosh LUTs (see below) and the HGCal noise/efficiency PSets.
- **`L1Trigger/Configuration/python/L1_Phase2_expanded_cff.py`:** the same content in a single file, with every object defined inline (like the Run-3 HLT menu dumps), to read the whole menu or diff two versions. `L1P2:Phase2_expanded` loads it; the resulting configuration is identical (`edmConfigDump`) to the one with `L1P2`.
- **`L1Trigger/Configuration/test/OnLine_L1_Phase2.py`:** a complete, runnable process (source, GlobalTag, geometry, output) running only the L1 emulation on the GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW output of the reference workflow, like `HLTrigger/Configuration/test/OnLine_HLT_GRun.py`.
- **`customisePhase2TTNoMC.customiseL1P2NoMCTruth`:** runs `L1P2` on stored events by dropping the MC-truth path (the tracker sim links are not stored) and loading `hcaltpdigi_cff`. Its HCAL trigger-tower ES producers are needed by the L1 emulation and are otherwise provided by DIGI; the live `L1TrackTrigger,L1,L1P2GT` steps have the same requirement.
- **P2GT LUTs defined once** (also in artlbv/cmssw#13): the cos/cosh LUTs are top-level PSets in `l1tGTLUTs_cfi`, loaded by `SimPhase2L1GlobalTrigger_cff`, and the double/triple/quad conditions reference them with `refToPSet_`. The resolved parameters are unchanged for all P2GT menus; `L1_Phase2_expanded_cff.py` goes from 1.9 MB to 0.57 MB.
- **Generator / validation:** `L1Trigger/Configuration/test/l1tPhase2Fragment.py generate|validate`.
  - The content is the difference between `cmsDriver -s DIGI:pdigi_valid` and `-s DIGI:pdigi_valid,L1TrackTrigger,L1,L1P2GT` for wf 38434.0 (the Run4 default, Run4D128, `Phase2C26I13M9`).
  - The files are generated and must not be edited by hand: changes go into the live `_cfi`/`_cff` files, followed by `generate`. The output doesn't depend on the Python hash seed.
- **cmsDriver step `L1P2[:<name>]`** (`ConfigBuilder`): loads `L1Trigger/Configuration/L1_<name>_cff` (default `Phase2`) in place of `L1TrackTrigger,L1,L1P2GT`.
- **Workflow variant `.783` (`L1P2Fragment`)** for all `Phase2C26I13M9` geometries (D120, D122, D123, D126, D127, D128). `prefixDet+34.783` (= `38434.783`) is added to the Run4 IB list.
- **Unit test `testL1Phase2Fragment`:**
  - checks the fragment against the live cmsDriver configuration (modules, parameters, ES objects, path order), so a change to the live L1 configuration without regeneration fails the test
  - checks that a `DIGI,L1P2,DIGI2RAW,HLT:@relvalRun4` config schedules every L1 path before HLT
- **Bug fix (first commit):** `l1tCaloJetHTT` read `("L1CaloJet","CaloJets")`, a product that doesn't exist in the Phase-2 L1 chain, so its HTT was always 0. It now reads `("l1tCaloJet","L1CaloJetCollectionBXV")`, the output of `l1tCaloJet`. This changes the `l1tCaloJetHTT` output.

The existing steps `L1TrackTrigger`, `L1` and `L1P2GT` are not modified; the standard workflows are unaffected apart from the `l1tCaloJetHTT` fix.

#### Validity

The L1 HGCal TPG configuration depends on the era, so the fragment is era-specific:

| Era | Geometries | Fragment vs live config |
|---|---|---|
| `Phase2C26I13M9` | D128 (default), D120, D122, D123, D126, D127 | identical |
| `Phase2C17I13M9` | D110, D114 | differs |
| `Phase2C22I13M9` | D121, D104, D111113, D124, D125 | differs |
| `Phase2C20I13M9` | D115 | differs (also HFNose TPG modules) |

Other eras would need their own fragment, which `L1P2:<name>` already supports.

#### PR validation:

- **`OnLine_L1_Phase2.py` on 3 D128 TTbar GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW events:** exit code 0. Its output is identical (705 L1 branches, entries and uncompressed sizes) to the live L1 rerun `-s L1TrackTrigger,L1,L1P2GT --customise L1Trigger/Configuration/customisePhase2TTNoMC.customisePhase2TTNoMC`; only `TriggerResults` differs.
- **With the MC-truth split and the shared LUTs, `DIGI,L1P2` vs `DIGI,L1TrackTrigger,L1,L1P2GT` from the same 3 D128 GEN-SIM events, with the same process name:** 855 identical output branches; only `TriggerResults` differs.
- **`validate`:** checks the fragment, the single file and `OnLine_L1_Phase2.py`, including the top-level PSets.

In `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-05-2300` (none of the later `master` commits touch the L1 configuration):
- `l1tPhase2Fragment.py validate` (both layouts): modules, parameters, ES objects and path order match the cmsDriver process for all six C26 geometries. Before the regeneration it failed on exactly the `l1tCaloJetHTT` change, so the drift check catches changes.
- `DIGI,L1P2` vs `DIGI,L1TrackTrigger,L1,L1P2GT` on 5 locally generated TTbar D128 events: same 851 output branches with the same entry counts and uncompressed sizes.
- `runTheMatrix.py -w upgrade -n`: lists without errors (1872 `.783` workflows); `38434.783` resolves to `-s DIGI:pdigi_valid,L1P2,DIGI2RAW,HLT:@relvalRun4`.
- `scram b runtests_testL1Phase2Fragment`: passes.

Earlier, in `CMSSW_20_1_0_pre1`, `DIGI,L1P2,DIGI2RAW,HLT:@relvalRun4` was also compared with the current steps: same paths in the same order (plus the legacy path) and identical parameters for all shared modules, HLT included.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport; no backport planned.
title: [L1T Phase-2] Standalone L1 emulation configuration L1_Phase2_cff and cmsDriver step L1P2
